summary: Tested 7 features: 1) Fuel Database multi-select for Categories, 2) Fuel Database multi-select for Industry Sectors, 3) Facilities toggle active/inactive button, 4) Facilities show inactive checkbox filter, 5) Facilities confirmation dialog for toggle, 6) Emissions delete button, 7) Emissions override inputs showing only unit label. All features verified successfully via backend API tests (12/12 passed) and frontend UI tests.

fuel_database_multi_select_categories.details: Form displays 'Select one or more categories:' text with clickable checkbox chips. Multiple categories can be selected (e.g., Stationary Combustion, Mobile Combustion). Selected chips are highlighted.

fuel_database_multi_select_industries.details: Form displays 'Select one or more industries:' text with clickable checkbox chips. Multiple industries can be selected (e.g., Manufacturing, Transportation). Selected chips show blue highlight.

facilities_toggle_button.details: Each facility card has a toggle button (PowerOff icon for active, Power icon for inactive). Button triggers confirmation dialog before toggling. Backend API PATCH /facilities/{id}/toggle-active works correctly.

facilities_show_inactive_filter.details: Checkbox 'Show inactive' present in facilities page header. When checked, inactive facilities are displayed. Page subtitle shows '(2 active)' count.

facilities_toggle_confirmation_dialog.details: AlertDialog with title 'Deactivate Facility' appears when clicking toggle. Message explains: 'This will hide all emissions from this facility and prevent user assignments.' Cancel and Deactivate buttons present.

emissions_delete_button.details: Delete button (red Trash2 icon) visible on each emission card with data-testid='delete-emission-{id}'. Backend DELETE /emissions/{id} API works correctly. 404 returned for non-existent emissions.

emissions_override_unit_badge.details: Override inputs for Calorific Value and Density show styled unit badge (bg-stone-100 rounded span) displaying only the unit (e.g., 'MJ/kg', 'kg/L') not the value. Input field is separate from unit display.

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: FuelDatabase.js properly implements multi-select with checkbox chips and visual state (lines 362-416)
GOOD: Backend FuelDatabaseCreate model supports both categories[] and industry_sectors[] arrays with backward compatibility for legacy single fields
GOOD: Facilities.js toggle button has proper data-testid for testing (line 729)
GOOD: Confirmation dialog provides clear messaging about consequences of deactivation
GOOD: Emissions override inputs correctly show unit in styled badge separate from input field (lines 1378-1430)

Facilities has toggle active/inactive with confirmation dialog and show inactive filter. Emissions has working delete button and override inputs show only unit badge not value.
